edits.english: Change of offering type - For example: if one slaughtered a sin offering for the sake of a burnt offering.

edits.hebrew: שינוי בעלים - חטאת ראובן ששחטה לשם שמעון להתכפר בה שמעון, דקיימא לן [לקמן] דפסולה, דכתיב: לכפר עליו ולא על חבירו:
edits.english: Change of owner - For example: Reuven's sin offering that Reuven slaughtered for the sake of Shimon, for Shimon to achieve atonement through it. For we hold (later on) that it is disqualified, as it is written: “to atone for him” and not for his fellow.
